firmware.releaseNotes: Check Update validation release for the installed 3.3.33 firmware. Retains the one-shot Bluetooth module reset at MCU startup, automatic companion reconnection, standalone Check Update menu, styled Chinese dialog and focus-group exit fix. Preserves explicit installation consent, recorder exclusion, BLE V2, module settings and file management. The operator-selected 3.3.33 delta must match the exact installed base image; other bases retain full-package fallback.
